title: Your First Weekend at Augustana College, Shared as Cards
description: Navigate your first days as a Viking with this sequence of essential campus stops, from the opening convocation to late-night snacks.

cards.title: Attend Opening Convocation
cards.subtitle: Friday Afternoon Kick-off
cards.notes: Join the Class of 2030 at Lindberg Stadium for the official welcome from President Talentino. This required event marks the start of your academic journey.
cards.short_summary: The official welcome ceremony for new students held at the football stadium.
cards.evidence_claim: Opening Convocation for the Class of 2030 is scheduled for Friday, Aug. 28, 2026, at 1 p.m. at Charles D. Lindberg Stadium.
cards.access_notes: Required for all new students; seating is in the north bleachers.

cards.title: Lunch at Gerber Center
cards.subtitle: First On-Campus Meal
cards.notes: Head to the top floor of the Gerber Center for a complimentary lunch with your family and new peers before the afternoon sessions begin.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus dining hall featuring multiple international food stations.
cards.evidence_claim: Complimentary lunch for students and families is served in the Gerber Center Dining Room from 11 a.m. to 12:45 p.m. on move-in Friday.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; weekend hours are typically 9 a.m. to 7 p.m. or 8 p.m.

cards.title: Pick Up Your Viking Gear
cards.subtitle: Brunner Theatre Center Lower Level
cards.notes: Visit the bookstore to grab your textbooks and Augustana apparel. It stays open throughout the first weekend to accommodate new arrivals.
cards.short_summary: The official campus store for textbooks, supplies, and college-branded merchandise.
cards.evidence_claim: The bookstore is open Friday 8 a.m.-4:30 p.m., Saturday 10 a.m.-4 p.m., and Sunday 1-3 p.m. during Welcome Week.
cards.access_notes: Located in the lower level of the Brunner Theatre Center.

cards.title: Walk the Slough Path
cards.subtitle: Evening Campus Stroll
cards.notes: Take a walk along the iconic Slough path that connects the residential and academic sides of campus. Look for turtles and frogs in the water.
cards.short_summary: A central campus waterway and landmark with a paved walking path.
cards.evidence_claim: The Slough is a historic campus landmark with a pathway connecting residential and academic areas.
cards.source_title: Slough water ebbs and flows through history at Augustana

cards.title: Explore Campus Recreation
cards.subtitle: Saturday Morning Workout
cards.notes: Check out the 200-meter track and basketball courts. It's a great spot to meet people through intramural sports or open gym hours.
cards.short_summary: The main student recreation facility featuring courts, a track, and a weight room.
cards.evidence_claim: PepsiCo Recreation Center is open Saturdays from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. and Sundays from 10 a.m. to 10 p.m.

cards.title: Visit the Dinosaur Gallery
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Culture
cards.notes: See the 22-foot long Cryolophosaurus skeleton and other fossils. This museum is one of the finest geology collections in the Midwest.
cards.short_summary: A campus museum housing extensive rock, mineral, and fossil specimens.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fryxell Geology Museum is open Saturdays and Sundays from 1 p.m. to 4 p.m. when classes are in session.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Swenson Hall of Geosciences.

cards.title: Find Your Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Sunday Prep Session
cards.notes: Explore the four floors of the library to find your favorite study nook before classes start on Monday. The Learning Commons is also located here.
cards.short_summary: The central academic library and hub for student success services.
cards.evidence_claim: Thomas Tredway Library is the main campus library and houses the Learning Commons.
cards.access_notes: Check LibCal for specific weekend hours; typically open until late evening on Sundays.

cards.title: Photo Op at Old Main
cards.subtitle: Iconic Campus Landmark
cards.notes: Snap a photo in front of the copper-domed Old Main. It's the most historic building on campus and houses many humanities departments.
cards.short_summary: The historic, copper-domed centerpiece of the Augustana campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Main is the most iconic building on campus, built between 1884 and 1893.
cards.access_notes: Exterior is always accessible; interior open during academic hours.

cards.title: Coffee at The Brew
cards.subtitle: Casual Sunday Afternoon
cards.notes: Grab a latte and a pastry at this campus coffee shop. It's a popular spot for casual meetings and has a great outdoor patio.
cards.short_summary: A campus coffee shop offering drinks, pastries, and grab-and-go food.
cards.evidence_claim: Brew by the Slough is located in the Gerber Center and is open Saturdays and Sundays from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m.
cards.source_title: Dining locations and hours | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Located on the fourth floor of the Gerber Center.

cards.title: Late Night Snack Run
cards.subtitle: Sunday Night Essentials
cards.notes: Stock up on snacks for your first week of classes. This convenience store is open late on Sunday nights for last-minute needs.
cards.short_summary: A campus convenience store located near the residence halls.
cards.evidence_claim: Westerlin Market is open from 2 p.m. to midnight on Sundays.
cards.source_title: Dining locations and hours | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Located in the Westerlin Residence Hall complex.
